patch.value: Preserve imported GitHub lifetimes, closure evidence and release attribution while linking cross-provider items

Repair the import root cause behind twelve Sourcery findings across six gated sync PRs. Preserve source timestamps through supported SDK metadata, map closure reasons and evidence, select tag-date release windows, report state conflicts, and link existing provider owners before creating items. Verify with recorded API fixtures and real temporary trackers at unchanged release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Read all twelve unresolved Sourcery threads and the changed tracker/changelog files in the six consumer sync PRs. Scope: fix import only; preserve append-only history and leave unrelated closeout work untouched. The pinned SDK exposes completedAt but reserves created_at, updated_at and closed_at; source timestamp metadata plus an explicit SDK-gap receipt is required unless a supported import path proves otherwise. No upstream SDK issue will be filed under the queue rules.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Found public SDK import primitives beyond high-level create/update: item locks, canonical document serialization, before/after history entries and appendHistoryEntry. Implementing an idempotent finalization event with real native dates and source metadata, without modifying any historical record. Existing provider owners receive provenance links only; their content, native lifecycle, release and export identity remain authoritative. Local Git calendar tag dates select the first release at or after source closure; later closures remain pending. GraphQL ClosedEvent closer provides actual closing PR attribution where REST commit_id is null.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: SDK candidate: bulk compensation captures native updated_at and passes it to restore as a history timestamp. Backdating that field disconnects the rollback version from its event. Preserve source creation/closure/completion natively for momentum and cycle time, and retain the exact source update date in github_updated_at while native updated_at stays the SDK mutation clock. Lifecycle finalization now runs at the SDK committing transition before the journal commits, with real compensation acceptance and a post-recovery idempotent check. No historical entries are rewritten.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Verified the SDK candidate with a real temporary tracker and public commitImportedItem/commitItemMutations calls: a historical native updated_at followed by an update and deliberate committing failure produces AggregateError, compensation_failed=true, original_restored=false. The importer retains the exact source update timestamp in github_updated_at while keeping native updated_at aligned with immutable event time. Real importer rollback acceptance restores the existing source lifecycle and deletes the newly created item. Focused corrections passed 7/7; final linked tests and unchanged full release gates are running.
